snippet.title: "The End of History" Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
"The End of History" is a sandbox strategy RPG set in a medieval-inspired world.
You begin as a nobody. Trade, raid, enter a lord's service, build a nation. Amid the competing agendas of countless NPCs, you choose how to live and live out a story that happens only once.

PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S versions have been announced, planned for Q1 2027 alongside the Steam 1.0 release.

Title: "The End of History"
Genre: Sandbox strategy RPG
Platforms: PC (Steam) / PlayStation 5 / Xbox Series X|S
Release: PC version in Early Access now / PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S versions planned for Q1 2027

Steam store page:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2953520/
